<div class="card-body">
'''Zev Senesca''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ゼヴ・セネスカ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。ローグ２を操縦するなら回避値に３を加え、戦闘運命数を引けない場合にも１枚引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Zev-Senesca-PSA-85187817.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ベスティーン星系に近いケスティック・ステーションの出身。あらゆる機種を乗りこなす温和なパイロット。ホスの氷原でルークとハンを発見した。ホスの戦いではローグ2を操縦。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Zev Senesca.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 2, also add 3 to maneuver, and may draw one battle destiny even if not able to otherwise.

'''Lore:'''
Born at Kestic Station near the Bestine system. A mild-mannered pilot who can handle every craft. He found Luke and Han on Hoth's ice plains. He piloted Rogue 2 at the Battle of Hoth.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore calls him 温和な (mild-mannered); English says daring.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Zev Senesca]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
